items.title: Gate-push fix (4f77e2f)
items.state: complete on its own code line, not used by the LangGraph runtime
items.detail: Branch live/gate-push-binding (4f77e2f, built on the ledger commit 61ca8c9) makes git_push publish only the commit the gate approved, then checks every push destination. The final independent review accepted it with no defect for the race and verifier fix. This was an offline review of a public branch: it is not a rollout, a live run or a security certification. Source check: the execution code line (d4a7485) shares only an old common ancestor with this line and does not contain or call this executor, so there is nothing to integrate and no integration progress is claimed. Known limits: the branch tip is read once and not atomically, a single writer is assumed, and file-system and symlink trust are unchanged.
items.unlocks: Any use of this executor is a separate, later decision.
items.done_when: Complete as a fix on its own line. Wiring it anywhere would need its own reviewed change.

items.title: Remaining WP4 and WP9 work
items.detail: From the work-package record: WP9 still needs the request-ID join and a matched savings comparison; WP4 and WP10 need the Reviewer-skip guard, which is still unbuilt. No dependency of these on P1 or P2 has been established, so none is claimed. Separate small fix, in review: the LangGraph coordination bus (execution line d4a7485) treated an errored push as not landed when it could not read the remote, and then reset its commit and retried. This was reproduced offline in disposable local repositories. A fix is on branch live/p1-bus-ambiguous-push at a31ead6 (three commits on d4a7485): when the remote cannot be read the bus keeps the commit and stops; retry stays only for a provable absence; the answer, lease-release, seat and supervisor callers handle the unknown case without undoing or replaying it; and the check looks at every push destination, not the fetch URL. An independent offline review accepted the core and caller changes on their exact commits, and an adversarial probe found no defect in them. The third commit is an end-to-end lifecycle probe (tests only) showing a later supervisor poll neither restarts nor replays a stopped seat; its review is still pending. The same six files are staged unchanged for integration on branch live/p1-bus-integration-staging at 5e140fc (one commit on d4a7485, byte-identical), which passed all 31 offline test files in one sandbox, run by the author. A final review of that exact commit is pending before the execution line can move; it is not accepted and not a rollout. A clean absence reading permits the documented at-least-once retry but is not proof a commit never landed (late server completion and remote rewinds are not covered), so the bus is not exactly-once.
items.unlocks: Progress credit only when an independent review accepts the work.
items.done_when: Each item has its own accepted review.
